problems.symptom: Migrated page works but public URL/permalink differs or old links 404.
problems.cause: Route migration was treated as an internal frontend concern instead of an external contract.
problems.solution: Restore the canonical route or add an intentional redirect according to the migration map, then revalidate canonical and navigation links.
problems.prevention: Inventory public routes/permalinks and redirect behavior before implementation.

problems.symptom: Text, labels or link targets changed while only a visual migration was requested.
problems.cause: Builder rewrote content while translating presentation.
problems.solution: Restore source copy/targets from the content map; separate editorial changes into a new task.
problems.prevention: Treat content and presentation as separate contracts.

problems.symptom: A migrated page looks correct but a legacy interaction, form, filter or embed no longer works.
problems.cause: Plugin/shortcode behavior was classified as styling or ignored during audit.
problems.solution: Identify the owning plugin/shortcode contract and rebuild or replace the behavior explicitly.
problems.prevention: Inventory plugin, widget and shortcode contributions before migration.

problems.symptom: Many near-duplicate arbitrary spacing/color/size utilities appear across migrated pages.
problems.cause: Pages were styled independently without a token contract.
problems.solution: Identify repeated values, promote genuine tokens/shared patterns, and retain only justified one-offs.
problems.prevention: Define a small design-token vocabulary before mass migration.

problems.symptom: A migrated page contains unrelated data orchestration, UI sections and interactions in one large component.
problems.cause: Template translation was performed linearly without ownership boundaries.
problems.solution: Split by stable responsibilities and extract only real reusable/stateful behavior.
problems.prevention: Plan page orchestration and reusable component boundaries before coding.

problems.symptom: Generated icon cannot follow text/theme color or has inconsistent visual weight.
problems.cause: Hard-coded colors or inconsistent stroke/fill contract.
problems.solution: Normalize to the site icon contract and use currentColor when appropriate.
problems.prevention: Define icon style contract before generating the set.

problems.symptom: A migrated page is declared complete because it builds, but fidelity/refresh intent was never compared to legacy.
problems.cause: No visual baseline or declared visual intent.
problems.solution: Capture representative legacy/candidate states and classify delta against FIDELITY, REFRESH or REDESIGN.

problems.symptom: New route renders content but loses title, canonical, description, robots or structured data.
problems.cause: Frontend migration validated only DOM visuals/build output.
problems.solution: Restore required metadata through the selected rendering/delivery strategy and validate delivered output.
problems.prevention: Include SEO fields in each public route migration contract.

problems.symptom: WordPress/API secret or privileged credential appears in Vue source, env exposed to client, or built bundle.
problems.cause: Server configuration was copied into frontend code to preserve legacy integration.
problems.solution: Remove/rotate exposed secret and restore a server-side boundary or public-safe credential flow.
problems.prevention: Classify server-only configuration during audit and prohibit privileged data in client bundles.

problems.symptom: Same visible failure survives two similar Builder patches.
problems.cause: Implementation continued without changing the causal model.
problems.solution: Rollback failed candidate, run Context GC, enter Diagnostic Mode and route to Planner.
problems.prevention: Enforce hypothesis states and the two-attempt implementation budget.
